items: Always use new gaskets when replacing the fuel tank or component parts.
When re-installing, be sure to include the rubber protectors on the upper surfaces of the fuel tank and tank band.
Apply the proper torque to all tightening parts.

content.description: Diagram showing SST tool placement and torque specification of 310 kg-cm (22 ft-lb, 30 N·m) for fuel line connection

items: (a) Inspect the fuel lines for cracks, leakage or connections deformation.
(b) Inspect the fuel tank vapor vent system hoses and connections for looseness, sharp bends or damage.
(c) Inspect the fuel tank for deformation, cracks, fuel leakage or tank band looseness.
(d) Inspect the inlet pipe for damage or fuel leakage.
